marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: US cloud providers reported strong enterprise AI revenue growth while increasing full-year capital expenditure guidance for data center expansion and advanced AI accelerators.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained capex expansion reinforces earnings visibility for semiconductor suppliers and supply-chain hardware partners in both US and Asian semiconductor ecosystems.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of margin compression among hyperscalers if enterprise AI monetization curves lag heavy capital expenditure and infrastructure depreciation costs.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech & China Internet Valuation Rerating
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index gained as major internet platforms executed expanded share buyback programs and reported accelerated growth in cloud and international e-commerce segments.
marketLayer.inference: Enhanced capital return yields combined with stabilized core earnings provide a defensive buffer, attracting institutional inflows back into cash-generative HK tech equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential regulatory shifts in cross-border data transfers and persistent softness in broader Chinese domestic consumer discretionary spending.

marketLayer.title: Fed Rate Trajectory & Hong Kong Banking Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: US macroeconomic indicators showed cooling core inflation alongside steady labor metrics, keeping market expectations aligned for monetary easing in the second half of the year.
marketLayer.inference: Expectations of lower US benchmark rates alleviate pressure on the HKD peg, facilitating a decline in HIBOR and reducing corporate borrowing costs for HK-listed equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Resurgent global inflationary risks driven by geopolitical supply chain disruptions could delay policy rate cuts, prolonging tight liquidity conditions.
